Provenance.drafts: 16 candidates generated locally via ComfyUI (SDXL base 1.0) at the frozen Active-track settings, seeds AssetSeed.SeedFor(id)+0..15, written to the gitignored art/pipeline/candidates/ scratch dir and curated off a per-id contact sheet. Yield was low and worth recording: the FIRST batch, on the master negative alone, returned 8 of 8 concept sheets (multi-blade variation plates, inventory grids, framed plaques on parchment), which is why ItemSpecsLadder carries the SingleItemOnDark NegativeExtra escalation.
Provenance.paintoverNote: No hand-finish, no paintover. Two mechanical stages only, both scripted: BiRefNet cutout via art/pipeline/cutout.py --trim, then an offline LANCZOS downsample so the long edge is 112px. That size is deliberate — ShopPanel.ItemArtSize is 56 and UiKit.ArtRect draws with ExpandMode.IgnoreSize + KeepAspectCentered, so the texture is scaled into a 56x56 box no matter what it ships at. The 42 sibling item icons ship at 200-500px and are downscaled 4-9x every frame for nothing; 112 is a 2x reserve over the draw box instead.
Provenance.aiDisclosure: AI-generated (SDXL base 1.0) diffuse, background-removed via BiRefNet (cutout.py, --trim); no normal map (flat menu icon per AssetSpec.NormalMap=false — item icons render in panels, never under Light2D).
